text: Outside Paris, Dr. Génessier keeps his daughter Christiane hidden in a mansion beside his clinic, guarded by dogs, and [promises to restore the face|wants|getting back the lost] a car crash destroyed. His assistant Louise lures [young women|who_suffers|teenagers and young adults] there, and he [cuts away their facial skin|threat|science playing god] to graft onto his child. Behind [her mask|images|dolls, masks and likenesses], Christiane watches each graft fail, phones her fiancé without a word, and slowly loses her mind from guilt and isolation.
